metadata.question: Were chlorophyll concertrations at 100km radius around (-41.729403, -125.410394) up during November 2019 to February 2020 in comparison to the same time the prior year?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Aqua L3SMI ocean color chlorophyll-a (NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI), filter within 100 km of the given point for two periods: 2018-11-01 to 2019-03-01, and 2019-11-01 to 2020-03-01. If a period has 0 images, retry with a ±15-day wider window. 2. Masking strategy: L3 chlorophyll is already masked over invalid pixels; additionally mask non-positive values (<= 0). Not a cloud question; compute valid pixel coverage fraction using count vs. total pixels at 4 km scale. 3. Logic to distinguish valid zero vs. null/error: If collections exist but valid pixel count after masking is 0, return C2. If mean is null/NaN or outside plausible range (>1000 or <=0), return C3. If operations fail, return D. Otherwise compare means; increase = A, else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lon = -125.410394; const lat = -41.729403; const region = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]).buffer(100000); // 100 km radius const scale = 4000; const p1Start = '2018-11-01'; const p1End = '2019-03-01'; // exclusive const p2Start = '2019-11-01'; const p2End = '2020-03-01'; // exclusive // Helper to get stats for a period function getPeriodStats(startStr, endStr, label) { // Base collection let col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .select('chlor_a') .filterDate(startStr, endStr) .filterBounds(region); let size = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${label} Images: ${size}`); // Recovery if empty: widen date window by ±15 days if (size === 0) { const startW = ee.Date(startStr).advance(-15, 'day'); const endW = ee.Date(endStr).advance(15, 'day'); col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .select('chlor_a') .filterDate(startW, endW) .filterBounds(region); size = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${label} Recovery (±15d) Images: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { return { exitTag: 'C1' }; } } // Mask non-positive values col = col.map(function(img) { const band = img.select('chlor_a'); return img.updateMask(band.gt(0)); }); // Time-mean over the period const meanImg = col.mean().rename('chlor_a'); // Valid pixel count within region const validCount = ee.Number( meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a') ).getInfo(); // Total pixel count (at given scale) const totalCount = ee.Number( ee.Image.constant(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('one') ).getInfo(); const validPct = totalCount > 0 ? (validCount / totalCount) * 100.0 : 0; if (!validCount || validCount === 0) { return { exitTag: 'C2', size, validCount, totalCount, validPct }; } // Spatial mean of time-mean chlorophyll const meanVal = ee.Number( meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a') ).getInfo(); if (meanVal === null || isNaN(meanVal) || meanVal <= 0 || meanVal > 1000) { return { exitTag: 'C3' }; } console.log(`${label} Valid Pixels: ${validCount}/${totalCount} (${validPct.toFixed(1)}%)`); console.log(`${label} Mean chlor_a (mg/m^3): ${meanVal.toFixed(3)}`); return { exitTag: null, size, validCount, totalCount, validPct, meanVal }; } console.log('Dataset: NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI chlor_a'); // 2. Data Acquisition & Checks const s1 = getPeriodStats(p1Start, p1End, '2018-2019 (Nov–Feb)'); if (s1.exitTag) { console.log(`Early exit: ${s1.exitTag}`); console.log(s1.exitTag); return; } const s2 = getPeriodStats(p2Start, p2End, '2019-2020 (Nov–Feb)'); if (s2.exitTag) { console.log(`Early exit: ${s2.exitTag}`); console.log(s2.exitTag); return; } // 3. Calculation: change assessment const diff = s2.meanVal - s1.meanVal; const pct = s1.meanVal > 0 ? (diff / s1.meanVal) * 100.0 : null; if (!isFinite(diff) || (pct !== null && !isFinite(pct))) { console.log('Invalid change calculation.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Change: ${diff.toFixed(3)} mg/m^3 (${pct !== null ? pct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%)`); // 4. Final Answer const answer = diff > 0 ? 'A' : 'B'; console.log(answer); } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
